verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires photos to be incorporated into the final proposal layout, defining an implementation-relevant document-design behavior.
The client establishes an implementation-relevant selection rule requiring inclusion of photos marked with asterisks.
First target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports placing proposal images in organic-shaped frames in the delivered draft.
The client changes the document-layout behavior by requiring two favored photos to be relocated if they cannot remain in the one-page letter.
The client explicitly changes Page 19 photo content by excluding one identified image and permitting substitution or a one-photo layout.
Post-modification target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports relocating the letter photos and completing the requested Page 19 removal and substitution.
